code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    points = {(r, c): value for r, row in enumerate(grid)
              for c, value in enumerate(row) if value}
    colors = list(dict.fromkeys(points.values()))
    period = len(colors)

    # Select the direction followed by the colored clue lines.
    directions = [(0, 1), (1, 0), (1, 1), (1, -1)]
    counts = []
    for dr, dc in directions:
        counts.append(sum((r + dr, c + dc) in points
                          for r, c in points))
    dr, dc = directions[counts.index(max(counts))]

    def phase(r, c):
        if (dr, dc) == (0, 1):
            return r % period
        if (dr, dc) == (1, 0):
            return c % period
        if (dr, dc) == (1, 1):
            return (r - c) % period
        return (r + c) % period

    mapping = {phase(r, c): value for (r, c), value in points.items()}
    return [[mapping[phase(r, c)] for c in range(w)] for r in range(h)]
'''
p.write_text(code)
exec(compile(code,str(p),'exec'))
